title: Paid run red: host tests need ssh-keygen in the clean image
what: The clean-image quick gate (podman) runs tests/test_gate_hosts.py Add tests, which call ssh-keygen through lib/relay_hosts.py; the image has no ssh-keygen. Either the tests stop depending on the real program (a fake on PATH, as the ssh tests do) or the image installs it; pick the one that keeps the tests honest and say why.
why: Paid run on master 065ffa05, 30 Oct 2026: ci RED, the clean-image quick gate failed and the paid evals were not started. The Mac gate passes because macOS has ssh-keygen.
failing_case: bin/ci on master 065ffa05: clean image quick gate FAILED; 4 errors in test_gate_hosts.Add, each FileNotFoundError: [Errno 2] No such file or directory: 'ssh-keygen'.
